sources.entry: claude-code-status-bar by briansmith80 - Configurable status bar for Claude Code: usage limits with pacing markers, context window, git state, live activity, session cost, and 8 colour themes. Pure bash, zero dependencies.

summary.one_liner: A configurable Claude Code status bar, written in pure bash, that shows usage limits with pacing markers, context window fill, git state, live tool activity, and session cost.
summary.what_it_does: The script reads the JSON Claude Code pipes to it and prints one to three lines under each response. Line one can show the directory, git branch and dirty/ahead/behind counts, model, context bar, 5-hour and weekly usage bars, duration, and session cost. The usage bars include a pacing marker showing where usage should be for even consumption, and a burn-rate forecast warning when a limit is likely to be hit before reset. Context bar marks the point where Claude Code auto-compacts and warns before it. An optional Node.js helper parses the transcript to show running tools, tool counts, subagents, and todo progress on a second line, and another optional helper restyles subagent panel rows. Usage data comes from stdin, with a background OAuth API fallback for older Claude Code versions. Eight colour themes and many per-segment toggles are configurable through statusline.conf, and the script includes self-update and uninstall commands.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code rate limit usage while working
see context window fill before auto-compact happens
show git branch and changes in the Claude Code prompt area
track session cost and burn rate
watch live tool and subagent activity in Claude Code
customise a terminal status line colour theme
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (macOS / Linux / Git Bash; URL truncated in the README)
stack: Node.js (optional, for activity line and subagent renderer)
notable: Pacing marker on usage bars shows whether usage is ahead or behind an even burn rate
Context bar is aware of Claude Code's auto-compact threshold and warns before it
Pure bash with no jq and no compiled binaries; Node.js is optional
Background subshells and cached data so the bar never blocks on network calls
caveats: Live activity line and subagent renderer need Node.js; without it those segments are off
On Windows the script runs through Git for Windows (Git Bash) and needs a refreshInterval of 2 or higher
OAuth usage fallback requires a token with the user:profile scope; tokens from claude setup-token do not work
keywords: see how much claude quota is left
